children: SKINN, the fine fragrance brand of Titan Company Limited, has launched Signatures, a two-fragrance collection comprising Silk Rose for women and Sea Breeze for men. The collection is priced at ₹4,495 for 100ml.

The launch took place at The St. Regis, Mumbai. Attendees included actor and SKINN brand ambassador Shobhita Dhulipala, Manish Gupta, CEO of Titan’s Fragrances and Accessories Division, and perfumers Nanako Ogi and Hamid Merati-Kashani, who created the two fragrances.
Two fragrances inspired by floral and marine notes

Silk Rose is a floral-fruity Eau de Parfum inspired by Turkish roses, with notes including lemon, raspberry, peony, jasmine and white musk. Sea Breeze is a woody-marine fragrance featuring bergamot, grapefruit, pink pepper, sandalwood and marine accords. Dhulipala and Ayushmann Khurrana, also a SKINN ambassador, feature in the respective product films.
Signatures will be sold at Titan World stores, SKINN kiosks, Shoppers Stop and Lifestyle, and on skinn.in. SKINN currently operates 18 kiosks in India.

SKINN reported 28 per cent year-on-year growth and expects to sustain growth of 20–25 per cent. It has about 5,000 distribution doors across more than 300 towns. E-commerce accounts for roughly 50 per cent of sales, retail 30 per cent and general trade 20 per cent. The brand aims to reach 8 million customers by FY30.
India’s fragrance market offers growth opportunities

The company said India’s fragrance market grew about 15 per cent in 2025, while formal fragrance penetration stands at an estimated 8–10 per cent. Men make up about 55 per cent of SKINN’s customers and women 45 per cent, compared with a 70:30 split in the traditional mass fragrance category.

“As consumers become increasingly discerning in their fragrance choices, we see a significant opportunity to elevate their experience,” Gupta said, adding that Signatures reflects the company’s ambition to strengthen its premium portfolio.
Launched in 2013, SKINN works with international perfumers and fragrance houses. Titan Company shares closed at ₹4,675.30 on the NSE on 27 November, up 0.95 per cent.

title: SKINN launches Signatures fragrance line with Silk Rose, Sea Breeze
